ObjectionSummary: Miracles violate the laws of nature and have never been scientifically verified. Rational people should not believe in them.
Response: Laws of nature describe how the world normally works; they do not forbid God from acting within it, any more than the laws of physics forbid a person from catching a falling ball. The question is evidence, not possibility. The resurrection has serious historical evidence, and millions report answered prayer and healing today. Dismissing all of it in advance is philosophy, not science.
